results.bestSpan: laying down the methodological and technical specifications in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/792 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the house price index and the owner-occupied housing price index
results.window: The data on the HPI is provided in the form of an overall index number comprising two sub-indexes: Purchases of newly built dwellings and Purchases of existing dwellings. The data is based on harmonized definitions and concepts included in the Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1470 of 17 July 2023 laying down the methodological and technical specifications in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/792 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the house price index and the owner-occupied housing price index, and amending Commission Regulation (EU) 2020/1148, and described in the Methodological Manual. HPIs give comparable measures for changes in the prices of dwellings.
